TARS Galaxy 1.4.0 - implementation references checked 2026-10-01

COVAS:NEXT
- Actions documentation:
  https://ratherrude.github.io/Elite-Dangerous-AI-Integration/20_actions/
- Plugin development:
  https://ratherrude.github.io/Elite-Dangerous-AI-Integration/plugins/Development/
- Native-first responsibilities used by the routing policy:
  system_finder, station_finder, body_finder, material_finder, blueprint_finder.
- station_finder supports station/service searches plus typed Raw, Manufactured
  and Encoded Material Traders and Human/Guardian Technology Brokers.
- Galaxy does not duplicate the native system/station action surface in 1.4.0.

Ardent API
- Base: https://api.ardent-insight.com/v2
- Repository/docs: https://github.com/iaincollins/ardent-api
- Nearest service:
  /v2/system/name/{systemName}/nearest/{service}
  /v2/system/address/{systemAddress}/nearest/{service}
- System records expose x/y/z coordinates.
- Nearest service supports minLandingPadSize.

EDData API
- Base: https://api.eddata.dev/v2
- Repository/docs: https://github.com/EDDataAPI/eddata-api
- Nearest service:
  /v2/system/name/{systemName}/nearest/{service}
  /v2/system/address/{systemAddress}/nearest/{service}
- System records use systemX/systemY/systemZ in the current API overview.

EDSM API v1
- Docs: https://www.edsm.net/api-v1
- Raw-coordinate sphere search:
  GET https://www.edsm.net/api-v1/sphere-systems?x=...&y=...&z=...&radius=...
- Radius maximum documented as 100 ly.
- Used to bridge an unindexed journal StarPos origin to a nearby named system
  known to a nearest-service provider; the proxy is never treated as the real origin.

EDSM Commander API
- Optional private fallback/verification for inventory, credits, ranks and last position.
- Live COVAS/journal state remains authoritative for current state.
- Credentials stay in plugin settings and are never returned to the model.
